bakeMechanism.note: frame() OVERWRITES uniforms.uReliefBakeStrength every frame with grainCarveUI.reliefBakeStrength * bakeReliefCrossover(sVis) (world-engine-lab.html:5746). So the controllable input is the BASE grainCarveUI.reliefBakeStrength (set via _lab.reliefBakeStrength(v)); the live/effective uniform is base * crossover(sVis).
bakeMechanism.bakeReliefCrossover: 1 - smoothstep(0, BAKE_CROSS_SPAN=1.0, |log2(sVis)|). sVis=visScaleOf(r)=r^0.5. Values: r0.5->sVis0.707->crossover0.5; r2->sVis1.414->crossover0.5; r8->sVis2.828->crossover0.0.
